Note: what are the indications of initiating Insulin therapy in type 2 DM? (usually 1 injection per day)

Healthy lifestyle interventions and treatment with metformin remain the cornerstones of T2DM treatment in children and adolescents; however, insulin therapy is often required to control hyperglycemia.
Fluid replacement should always precede insulin therapy in the non-shocked patient

qs.q: After the first hour of fluid resuscitation in DKA, what is the recommended insulin therapy for a child over 5 years old?
o: Subcutaneous regular insulin at 0.2iu/kg/dose every 4 hours
qs.e: For children over 5 years old, after the first hour of fluids in DKA, regular insulin is started by infusion at a rate of 0.05 - 0.1iu/kg/hr.
